name: Hermes Testing Solutions Inc.
summary: Hermes Testing Solutions Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops and manufactures semiconductor testing and inspection equipment in Taiwan, the United States, Asia, and Europe. The company offers probe cards, including WAT, logic, LCD driver, and RF devices, as well as TF-MLC; and customized products, such as Hprobe, AOI toolkit, FIMS, TEMIC Mars X8/X8 Plus, D-sensor bridge beam, EasyCool, and laser cleaner.
